'''Flib''' was a [[Caarite]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Flib was a child during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and lived on [[Caarimon]], the Caarite homeworld. When the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Blik (Shistavanen)|Blik]] landed the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] ''[[Ku'Amo]]'' in [[Joventusek]] on Caarimon, Flib went and played around the ship, along with a group of other Caarite children.<ref name="BotB" /> A short time afterwards, Flib traveled to [[Dorumaa]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], to attend a celebration that was being held in honor of the [[heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="Paarty">{{LivingForce|Paarty On!}}</ref>
